items.title: Cross-Border Ownership and Input Access: Evidence from the Lithium Supply Chain
items.author: Kei Irizawa
items.summary: How does cross-border ownership shape the lithium supply chain? items.title: Dull, Dirty, Dangerous? Working Conditions and the Limits of Occupational AI Exposure
items.author: Siyi Yu
items.summary: Automation is often justified as relief from dull, dirty, and dangerous work. I examine how these conditions relate to occupational AI exposure using 21 O*NET items across 754 US occupations.
